name: redevops-demo
description: Self-demonstrating ReDevOps × AWS deploy-and-operate demo: one prompt in Projects provisions, secures, monitors and self-heals a real EKS stack — governed by Mission Runtime, optimized by Context Runtime.

paragraphs: What it does. A governed deploy-and-operate demo: missions plan, gate (human approval), "provision", scan, harden, and remediate an EKS-shaped stack, with every consequential step gated and replayable. Everything runs against in-process simulators ($0, SIM=1). The repo also contains Terraform for AWS (and Azure/GCP/DigitalOcean) and a real-mode path, but no real cloud apply is claimed or evidenced here: "real apply" is listed under Next. Despite older wording elsewhere, this repo does not currently provision, secure or self-heal a real EKS stack.
Who it's for. People evaluating how Mission Runtime, Context Runtime and Sidekick fit together on a deploy-and-operate workflow, and contributors to those projects.
Maturity: simulation-only. (version 0.0.0, no tags or releases; see STATUS.md.)
